claim_boundary: Exact finite algebra, combinatorics, and source RTL are separated from synthetic optical inference, ideal SIC modeling, queued exhaustive M36 work, and unobserved hardware/PDF evidence.

headlines.3003: The six general-isotropic M36 pilot hits are one 729-element orbit under a 34,992-element three-copy deep-ray symmetry; 495 pivot patterns reduce to 98 copy-permutation types. Full 213,648,435 census remains pending.
headlines.3004: A new 28-triangle schedule separates all 48,826 no/one/two-edge D4 fault hypotheses, improving the prior 29 construction.
headlines.3005: A synthesizable A4 shell uses the Fibonacci mod-2 action and an 89/233 Christoffel scheduler, with shell opcodes structurally unable to write the D4 core.
headlines.3006: Every skew line pair has a natural 3x4 flag fiber, giving 540x12=6480 transitively; no PGSp order-12 element acts as 12^540, so the clock dynamics is controller-added.
headlines.3007: Component counts now feed a Bayesian sequential chirality policy with explicit stopping cost; synthetic cost 1e-3 yields 99.659% success at 7.71 expected copies.
headlines.3008: The four V4 shell labels form a tetrahedral A4 information geometry with an exact covariant SIC readout model.
headlines.3009: The 89/233 scheduler crossed with D12 gives a 2796-tick reversible calendar, 89 events per phase and gap alphabet {2,3}.
